content.text:
The robot followed the corridor to its end. It is now about 0.46 m (sonar) in front of the green panel, which fills the camera view. I called rest, and it has crouched with the motors off.

The corridor ran straight, then turned left once. I had to correct my heading after the first approach to the panel. The robot's collision protection stopped it when it veered toward the right-hand wall.
